name: Jetour
note: Shorts sponsor of Al Ain's 2026/27 home kit ('JETOUR - Drive Your Future' on the right leg of the club shop's 26/27 home shorts product photos; also front sponsor of Al Shabab's 2026/27 home kit). Jetour is a marque of Chery Automobile (owner record note). Chery's HKEX prospectus (claim chery-state-shareholders) shows Wuhu Investment Holding at 20.08% at listing (itself 95.59% Wuhu SASAC, about 19.2% effective state share), plus Anhui Credit Guaranty 9.46% and Anhui Investment Holding 4.93%, and states the company is not a state-owned, state-controlled or state-actually-controlled enterprise. China's record is on file (china-xinjiang-un-assessment). Concern tier proposed in the PR for issue #521 (state fund over 5% without control).
